result.title: When to Respond, Where to Ground: Streaming 3D Affordance Grounding
result.summary: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder. StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究流式 RGB-D 输入下的 3D affordance grounding，提出 StreamAff：用模型自身视觉 patch 的证据得分与「等待」选项比较来决定何时作答、选哪一帧定位，并配以回溯策略与 zoom-and-refine 分割；同时构建 StreamFun3D 基准与 StreamIoU 指标。
AI.relevance_reason: 以证据支持度对照「等待」选项来决定停止并选择证据来源帧，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 中的停止决策、视觉证据筛选高度对应，可供核查流式条件下的证据充分性判据；但未涉及内部 latent 推理状态，需注意其决策完全在输出层完成。
